body.translated_text: <s>Dhvajāgrakeyūrā Dhāraṇī</s> (The Protective Spell of the Banner-Crest Armlet)

body.text: namo bhagavate dhvajāgra rājāya tathāgatāya arhate samyak sambuddhāya tadyathā |
body.translated_text: Homage to the Blessed One, <s>Dhvajāgrarāja</s> (King of Banner-Crests), the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the worthy one, the perfectly awakened one. It is as follows:

body.text: jaya jaya vijaya vijaya jayavāhini-sam gari prabhañjani prabhañjani sarva śatruṇām jambhaya jambhaya stambhaya stambhaya mohaya mohaya bhagavati jayavāhini mātha mātha pra-mātha pra-mātha grasa grasa hasa hasa huṃ huṃ lambodari trinetre caturmukhe caturvaktre catur daṃṣṭre catur bhuje asi musala khaḍga triśūla vajra dhāraṇīrakṣa rakṣa mām |
body.translated_text: Be victorious, be victorious! Be supremely victorious, be supremely victorious! O bearer of victory, O thundering one, O destroyer, O destroyer! Paralyze, paralyze all enemies! Petrify, petrify! Bewilder, bewilder! O Blessed bearer of victory, crush, crush! Thoroughly crush, thoroughly crush! Devour, devour! Laugh, laugh! <s>Hūṃ hūṃ</s>! O pot-bellied one, O three-eyed one, O four-faced one, O four-visaged one, O four-fanged one, O four-armed one, O bearer of the sword, pestle, scimitar, trident, and <s>vajra</s> (thunderbolt) <s>dhāraṇī</s>! Protect, protect me!

body.text: bhagavati hana hana daha daha paca paca mātha mātha pramātha pramātha huṃ huṃ phaṭphaṭbhañja bhañja sarva śatrūṇām |
body.translated_text: O Blessed One! Strike, strike! Burn, burn! Cook, cook! Crush, crush! Thoroughly crush, thoroughly crush! <s>Hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ</s>! Shatter, shatter all enemies!

body.text:
dhvajāgra keyure tisṭhat tisṭhat triṭa ulkā dhāraṇi trailokyanātha vidhvaṃśaya
para sainya rakṣa rakṣa māṃ cala cala cili cili culu culu kala kala kili kili kulu kulu muncaṭṭa hāsaya vidhvaṃśaya parasainya bhramaya |
body.translated_text:
O <s>Dhvajāgrakeyūrā</s> (Banner-Crest Armlet)! Stand firm, stand firm! <s>Triṭa</s>! O bearer of the firebrand! O lord of the three worlds, destroy
the enemy army! Protect, protect me! <s>Cala cala cili cili culu culu kala kala kili kili kulu kulu</s>! Release a thunderous laugh! Destroy the enemy army! Confound!

body.text: buddha satyena dharma satyena saṃgha satyena satya vādināṃ satyena buddha satyāmatikrama dharma satyāṃ atikrama saṃgha satyāṃ atikrama satya vādinaṃ satyamatikrama |
body.translated_text: By the truth of the <s>Buddha</s>, by the truth of the <s>Dharma</s>, by the truth of the <s>Saṃgha</s>, by the truth of those who speak truth! Do not transgress the truth of the <s>Buddha</s>! Do not transgress the truth of the <s>Dharma</s>! Do not transgress the truth of the <s>Saṃgha</s>! Do not transgress the truth of those who speak truth!

body.text: lambodare kuṭṭa kuṭṭa kuṭṭya kuṭṭya rudra mānaya biṣṇu mānaya candra sūrya mānaya trailokya adhipatya mānaya sarva devo mānaya sarva yakṣa rākṣasa gandharva kinnara mahoraga mānaya vidhvamsaya mama sarva śatru vaḥ rangha rangha ranghāpaya ranghāpaya jvala jvala puṣpa mālini liḍhi liḍhi triṭa triṭa bhṛkuti mukhaḥ parasainya kurucchedana karaṇha ha hi hi hu hu he he riṇi riṇi riṇā māte jayantu dhvaje |
body.translated_text: O pot-bellied one! Pound, pound! Crush, crush! Summon <s>Rudra</s>! Summon <s>Viṣṇu</s>! Summon the Moon and Sun! Summon the lord of the three worlds! Summon all gods! Summon all <s>Yakṣas</s>, <s>Rākṣasas</s>, <s>Gandharvas</s>, <s>Kinnaras</s>, and <s>Mahoragas</s>! Destroy all my enemies! Color, color! Cause to color, cause to color! Blaze, blaze! O garland of flowers! Lick, lick! <s>Triṭa triṭa</s>! O frowning-faced one! O one who causes the cutting down of the enemy army! <s>Ha ha hi hi hu hu he he riṇi riṇi riṇāmāte</s>! May (they) be victorious at the banner!

body.text: buddhāvalokite rakṣa rakṣa mama bhagavatāvalokite svāhā | guṇa rāja prabhāse svāhā | suryārka vimale svāhā | sarva graha nakṣatra dā me karaṇa svāhā |
body.translated_text: O one beheld by the <s>Buddha</s>, protect, protect me! O one beheld by the Blessed One, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Guṇarājaprabhāsa</s> (Radiance of the King of Virtues), <s>svāhā</s>! To the immaculate sun, <s>svāhā</s>! To all <s>grahas</s> (planets) and <s>nakṣatras</s> (lunar mansions), grant me (protection), <s>svāhā</s>!
